capabilities: Colors file explorer names by level
extras: Manual install only (copy files into .obsidian/plugins); runs offline and uses the local clipboard.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to recolor bold or italic text, click-to-copy inline code, or color-code file explorer entries by depth or link usage.
summary: Markdown styling tool that recolors bold and italic text, copies inline code on click, and colors file explorer names by level or missing links.
